title: GDScript: Remove Variant copy in `set`
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Speeds up GDScript setters

## Additional information

Uses the same mechanism from #123531 to avoiding copying a Variant when an implicit conversion is possible.

## Benchmarks

Project: [gdscript-set.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32498266/gdscript-set.zip)

<details>
<summary>Setup and scenarios</summary>

Class to set value on:
```gdscript
class_name A extends Object

var x: int
var y: Y

class Y extends RefCounted:
	pass
```

### A: Int

```gdscript
var a := A.new()
for i in N:
    a.x = 1
```

### B: Float

```gdscript
var a := A.new()
for i in N:
    a.x = 1.1
```

### C: RefCounted

```gdscript
var a := A.new()
var y := A.Y.new()
for i in N:
    a.y = y
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Device specs</summary>
CPU: AMD 9800X3D, GPU: AMD RX 6800, RAM: 32GB DDR5 6400 CL28, Windows 11, Built with GCC (MinGW)
</details>

Each scenario is run in a loop of `N=100_000_000`. The test is run 15 times on release templates and the 20th percentile is summarized below:

| Scenario | PR (ns/op) | Master (ns/op) | Diff | Speedup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A (int) | 1.315 | 1.382 | 0.067 | 1.05x |
| B (float -> int) | 1.315 | 1.380 | 0.065 | 1.05x |
| C (RefCounted) | 3.129 | 4.922 | 1.793 | 1.57x |
